entries.c35397afec06333a: Its strength lies in the technology accumulated by the core company, Uesuko Inc., since its founding in 1970, and in a structure in which group subsidiaries cover a wide range of fields, including surveying, geological surveys and environmental impact assessment.
entries.c653d34c65d32b89: Under its corporate philosophy 'A Society in Coexistence with Nature to Leave for the Future,' the group positions its General Construction Consulting Business in social infrastructure, its Sports Facility Operation Business in health, and its Aquarium Operation Business in social education, and its management policy is contributing to local communities and sustainably increasing corporate value. The First Medium-Term Management Plan, covering the period from the fiscal year ended July 2024 to the fiscal year ended July 2026, positions this period as one for rebuilding its business foundation and sets out human resources, technology and market strategies; under the market strategy, it cites as priority business development areas disaster prevention and mitigation-related work, expanding orders in the Kanto and Kyushu regions, expanding franchised sports facility outlets, and opening new small city-type aquariums.
